result.topic_en: Formula-only notes on a hyperelliptic integral with branch points 0, 1, 1/κ, 1/λ, 1/μ, ∞, then a period-matrix scheme for p functions u_1,…,u_p with its row reduction and a determinant, followed by calculations with α, β, γ (and primed variants) that eliminate λ, λ', λ'' from linear relations.
result.transcription:
$\int \frac{\partial x}{\;\;}$ \quad $0 \quad 1 \quad \frac{1}{\kappa} \quad \frac{1}{\lambda} \quad \frac{1}{\mu} \qquad \infty$

$\int \frac{\partial x}{\sqrt{x(1-x)(1-\kappa x)(1-\lambda x)(1-\mu x)}} = u \quad \int x\,\partial u = \partial v$

$u_1 \; \pi i \; 0 \cdots 0 \; a_{1,1} \; a_{1,2} \cdots a_{1,p}$
$u_2 \; 0 \; \pi i \cdots 0 \; a_{1,2} \; a_{2,2} \cdots a_{2,p}$
$\cdots\cdots\cdots$
$u_p \; 0 \; 0 \cdots \pi i \; a_{1,p} \; a_{2,p} \cdots a_{p,p}$

$u_1 - \frac{a_{1,p}}{a_{p,p}} u_p \quad \pi i \; 0 \cdots 0 \; a_{1,1} \; a_{1,2} \cdots \frac{\pi i\, a_{1,p}}{a_{p,p}}$
$u_2 - \frac{a_{2,p}}{a_{p,p}} u_p \quad [-\pi-] \; \pi i \cdots 0 \; a_{1,2} \; a_{2,2} \cdots \frac{\pi i\, a_{2,p}}{a_{p,p}}$
$u_p \frac{\pi i}{a_{p,p}} \quad 0 \; 0 \cdots \pi i \; \frac{\pi i\, a_{1,p}}{a_{p,p}} \; \frac{\pi i\, a_{2,p}}{a_{p,p}} \cdots \frac{\pi \pi}{a_{p,p}}$

$w_1 \; \mathfrak{K}^{(1)}_1 \; \mathfrak{K}^{(2)}_1 \quad \mathfrak{K}^{p}_1 \; \mathfrak{L}^1_1 \cdots \mathfrak{L}^p_1$
$w_2 \; \mathfrak{K}^{(1)}_2 \; \mathfrak{K}^{2}_2 \quad \mathfrak{K}^{p}_2 \; \mathfrak{L}^1_2 \quad \mathfrak{L}^p_2$
$w_p \; \mathfrak{K}^{(1)}_p$

$\mathfrak{K}_1 \; w_1 \sum \pm \mathfrak{K}^2_2 \cdots \mathfrak{K}^p_p + w_2 (\cdots\cdots) \quad \cdots\cdots$

$\sum \pm \mathfrak{K}^1_1 \mathfrak{K}^2_2 \cdots \mathfrak{K}^p_p$

$1 + \alpha''\lambda'' = -\alpha\lambda - \alpha'\lambda'$
$1 + \beta''\lambda'' = -\beta\lambda - \beta'\lambda'$
$1 + \gamma''\lambda'' = -\gamma\lambda - \gamma'\lambda'$

$(\alpha'' - \beta'')\lambda'' = -([-(\alpha-\beta-]\alpha - \beta)\lambda - (\alpha' - \beta')\lambda')$
$(\alpha'' - \gamma'')\lambda'' = -(\alpha - \gamma)\lambda - (\alpha' - \gamma')\lambda'$

$\frac{1}{\gamma} - \alpha$
$\frac{(\frac{1}{\gamma} - \alpha)(\alpha'' - \beta'') + (\frac{1}{\gamma''} - \alpha'')(\beta - \alpha)}{(\frac{1}{\beta} - \alpha)(\alpha'' - \gamma'') + (\frac{1}{\beta''} - \alpha'')(\gamma - \alpha)} = \frac{(\frac{1}{\gamma} - \alpha)(\alpha' - \beta') + (\frac{1}{\gamma'} - \alpha')(\beta - \alpha)}{(\frac{1}{\beta} - \alpha)(\alpha' - \gamma') + (\frac{1}{\beta'} - \alpha')(\gamma - \alpha)}$

$(\alpha - \beta)\lambda + (\alpha' - \beta')\lambda' \quad (\alpha - \frac{1}{\beta})\lambda + (\alpha' - \frac{1}{\beta'})\lambda'$

$\frac{(\alpha - \beta)\lambda + (\alpha' - \beta')\lambda'}{(\alpha - \gamma)\lambda + (\alpha' - \gamma')\lambda'}$

$(\alpha - \beta)(1 - \frac{1}{\alpha\beta})\lambda + (\alpha' - \beta')(1 - \frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'})\lambda' + (\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha} - \frac{\beta'}{\beta})(1 - \frac{\alpha\beta}{\alpha'\beta'})\lambda\lambda' = 0$
$(\alpha - \gamma)(1 - \frac{1}{\alpha\gamma}) + (\alpha' - \gamma')(1 - \frac{1}{\alpha'\gamma'})\lambda' + (\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha} - \frac{\gamma'}{\gamma})(1 - \frac{\alpha\gamma}{\alpha'\gamma'})\lambda\lambda' = 0$

$\frac{\alpha'' + \frac{1}{\alpha''} - \beta'' - \frac{1}{\beta''}}{\alpha'' + \frac{1}{\alpha''} - \gamma'' - \frac{1}{\gamma''}} = \frac{(\alpha + \frac{1}{\alpha} - \beta - \frac{1}{\beta})\lambda + (\alpha' + \frac{1}{\alpha'} - \beta' - \frac{1}{\beta'})\lambda'}{(\alpha + \frac{1}{\alpha} - \gamma - \frac{1}{\gamma})\lambda + (\alpha' + \frac{1}{\alpha'} - \gamma' - \frac{1}{\gamma'})\lambda'}$

methods.what: Hyperelliptic integral of the first kind with branch points 0,1,1/κ,1/λ,1/μ,∞, plus a second integral defined from it
methods.quote: $\int \frac{\partial x}{\sqrt{x(1-x)(1-\kappa x)(1-\lambda x)(1-\mu x)}} = u \quad \int x\,\partial u = \partial v$

methods.what: Period scheme of normalized integrals u_1..u_p: periods πi on the diagonal and a symmetric matrix a_{i,j}
Row reduction of the period scheme by subtracting multiples of u_p and rescaling u_p by πi/a_{p,p}
methods.quote: $u_1 - \frac{a_{1,p}}{a_{p,p}} u_p \quad \pi i \; 0 \cdots 0 \; a_{1,1} \; a_{1,2} \cdots \frac{\pi i\, a_{1,p}}{a_{p,p}}$

methods.what: Expansion of a determinant of the period coefficients along its first column (cofactor expansion)
Elimination of λ'' from three linear relations by taking differences
Bilinear relations in λ, λ' obtained after elimination
Ratio relation expressed in terms of α+1/α
